items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: Went there and did it, went on the road with her for a year

ctx.x: Did you have a time when you felt this is my break? A phone call or an opportunity to play with someone that you felt was really a door opener for you?

Yeah. I’ve had that several times throughout my career. Well even my first gig out of high school which was that disco group that traveled along the East Coast. Because that was my dream at the time was to just get out and travel and play music every night. It didn’t matter what kind of music, I just wanted to play. So even that experience represented that to me. And then my first year in college I got a call from a friend of mine who was working with Stephanie Mills, who at the time had just come off of the lead…
opportunity that comes I felt like yeah, this is the door I’ve been looking to open. And it’s kept going that way.
